lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy8Ag4Te4 (reduced formula Dy2AgTe) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with a tetrahedral Te coordination of four neighbors, Dy centers with eight geometric neighbors (four Ag and four Te), and Te centers with four Dy neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ag tetrahedra and corner-sharing between Ag tetrahedra and Dy 8-vertex polyhedra.
